query_plan.query: What is the average area in square kilometers of Chinese provinces?

steps.merge_task: Deduplicate by province and calculate the average area.
steps.query: Return all provinces and areas in China, with their province id and province name.

extra.sql_query: SELECT AVG(provinces.area_km2) AS avg_area FROM provinces

s1.sql_query: SELECT provinces.province, provinces.area_km2, provinces.name FROM provinces
